description: Annotate a trade — the user-owned fields only: `notes` (free text about this trade), `tags`, `mistakes`, `playbookId`, `rating` 1–5, `stopLoss` and `profitTarget` (price levels; the stop is what realized R is measured against) and `reviewed`. `tags`/`mistakes` replace the whole list; use `addTags`/`removeTags`/`addMistakes`/`removeMistakes` to change a few entries without clobbering the rest (check journal_list_tags for the user's existing words). Pass null to clear a field. Does not touch fills, prices or P&L — those derive from the fills. Returns the updated trade in full. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

addTags.description: Tags to add (existing ones are kept; case-insensitive duplicates are ignored).

key.description: The trade's `key` exactly as returned by journal_list_trades, journal_get_day, journal_search_notes or journal_add_trade. Never construct one.

anyOf.description: Replace the whole mistakes list; null clears it. Not with addMistakes/removeMistakes.

notes.description: Replaces the trade's note text; null clears it.

playbookId.description: Playbook / setup name this trade followed; null clears it.

profitTarget.description: Planned target price; null clears it.

reviewed.description: Mark the trade reviewed (true) or not (false).

stopLoss.description: Planned stop price; null clears it.

anyOf.description: Replace the whole tag list; null clears it. Not with addTags/removeTags.

name: journal_update_trade
title: Annotate a journal trade
